snippet.title: Eyes Of The Factory - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
THE FACTORY NEVER FORGOT YOU.
NOW IT WANTS YOU BACK.

In the shadows of Blackforge Industries, something never shut down.
You return to the abandoned factory where rusted machines still breathe, forgotten halls still whisper, and unseen eyes follow every step. What was once a place of industry has become something else entirely—silent, broken, and waiting.

Some secrets were buried in steel.
Some never stopped watching.

Eyes of the Factory
Official Game Trailer
